commits.body:
# Aider chat conversation:

USER: add --openai-api-type --openai-api-version and openai-api-deployment-id args. pass them into coder.create

ASSISTANT: To add the `--openai-api-type`, `--openai-api-version`, and `--openai-api-deployment-id` arguments and pass them into `coder.create`, we need to modify the `aider/main.py` file.

Here are the steps:

1. Add the new arguments to the argument parser in the `main` function.
2. Pass these arguments to the `coder.create` function.

Here are the changes:

```python
aider/main.py
<<<<<<< ORIGINAL
    ##########
    model_group = parser.add_argument_group("Advanced Model Settings")
    model_group.add_argument(
        "--openai-api-base",
        metavar="OPENAI_API_BASE",
        default="https://api.openai.com/v1",
        help="Specify the OpenAI API base endpoint (default: https://api.openai.com/v1)",
    )
=======
    ##########
    model_group = parser.add_argument_group("Advanced Model Settings")
    model_group.add_argument(
        "--openai-api-base",
        metavar="OPENAI_API_BASE",
        default="https://api.openai.com/v1",
        help="Specify the OpenAI API base endpoint (default: https://api.openai.com/v1)",
    )
    model_group.add_argument(
        "--openai-api-type",
        metavar="OPENAI_API_TYPE",
        help="Specify the OpenAI API type",
    )
    model_group.add_argument(
        "--openai-api-version",
        metavar="OPENAI_API_VERSION",
        help="Specify the OpenAI API version",
    )
    model_group.add_argument(
        "--openai-api-deployment-id",
        metavar="OPENAI_API_DEPLOYMENT_ID",
        help="Specify the OpenAI API deployment ID",
    )
>>>>>>> UPDATED
```

```python
aider/main.py
<<<<<<< ORIGINAL
    coder = Coder.create(
        main_model,
        args.edit_format,
        io,
        args.openai_api_key,
        args.openai_api_base,
        ##
        fnames=args.files,
        pretty=args.pretty,
        show_diffs=args.show_diffs,
        auto_commits=args.auto_commits,
        dirty_commits=args.dirty_commits,
        dry_run=args.dry_run,
        map_tokens=args.map_tokens,
        verbose=args.verbose,
        assistant_output_color=args.assistant_output_color,
        code_theme=args.code_theme,
        stream=args.stream,
        use_git=args.git,
    )
=======
    coder = Coder.create(
        main_model,
        args.edit_format,
        io,
        args.openai_api_key,
        args.openai_api_base,
        ##
        fnames=args.files,
        pretty=args.pretty,
        show_diffs=args.show_diffs,
        auto_commits=args.auto_commits,
        dirty_commits=args.dirty_commits,
        dry_run=args.dry_run,
        map_tokens=args.map_tokens,
        verbose=args.verbose,
        assistant_output_color=args.assistant_output_color,
        code_theme=args.code_theme,
        stream=args.stream,
        use_git=args.git,
        openai_api_type=args.openai_api_type,
        openai_api_version=args.openai_api_version,
        openai_api_deployment_id=args.openai_api_deployment_id,
    )
>>>>>>> UPDATED
```

Please note that these changes assume that the `Coder.create` method and the `Coder` class are prepared to receive and handle these new arguments. If they are not, additional changes will be needed in the `Coder` class and its subclasses.
